text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One defeated Oguri Cap and the 
others. However, she was more exhausted 
than she had ever been before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Oguri Cap and Super Creek 
remained dignified even after the race, 
making Inari One keenly feel the gap in 
strength between them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next goal is the Arima Kinen. Pushing 
herself past her limits in training to 
secure a decisive victory over both of 
them this time, she ends up collapsing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Because she cared so deeply about everyone 
at Ohi, the mental burden of feeling she 
had to win at all costs pushed Inari One 
to her absolute limit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Feeling utterly ashamed of herself and 
unable to face her folks back home, Inari 
One sank into an unprecedented state of 
dejection—
